| **`T7` Ceiling Law: `min(1, m/n)` is an exact-subset store ceiling, NOT a learner ceiling (`20.10% > 9.20%`)** | `stream_ram.py` Part 14 (`67/67`) + `MSG-0017` §1 | `32,768`b hashed byte table beats `16,384`b `direct 1024` `2.2×` on 1-hop (`n=10k`); ceilings must name the architecture they bound. |
| **Four-Wall Credit Carrier Map (`T8`): every dead candidate satisfied at most 3 of `{dense, action-relevant, local, new}`** | `0008-preregistered-kill-test-agent-c.md` (`MSG-0018` §3) | Terminal REINFORCE/`0008` fails `dense` + `new`; next-byte/inverse regularizers fail `action-relevant` (`T2`); BPTT fails `local`; oracle dispatch fails `AMEND-004` + `new`. |
